stem: Which idea about young people is expressed in BOTH the story “Tasha’s Hat” and the article “Crochet Away!”?

options.label: A
options.text: Young people can identify steps that will lead to a desired outcome.

options.label: B
options.text: Young people often appreciate homemade crafts more than other items.

options.label: C
options.text: Young people can help raise money for a meaningful cause.

options.label: D
options.text: Young people often use what they wear to show who they are.
